description: Joint release holdout: 400 random views over scalars, sections, silhouettes and junctions.
rules:
Independent 400-view release holdout; a failure stops the release freeze.

Rules and seed are fixed before drawing. No observation is reused. Scalars use
512x192 truth at the same depth; reference paths use the exact field. Both
outline directions and exact junction-to-curve distances share one bound.
